method: manual source review via the live EURES public JSON API (https://europa.eu/eures/api/jv-searchengine/public/jv/id/{source_id}): each posting fetched live, stored title compared against the live title, and the live body read for role confirmation before translation. Not model output. 16 of 18 candidates in this window returned HTTP 200 with exact title matches and were filled. Two postings returned HTTP 404 (dead postings) and were skipped without a fill: 147fcc83a741b8ea (SI, VOGART) and 17bc5f470d4b0c6d (FI, Adecco/DHL night shift) - the dead-link sweep handles them. The five previously held postings (00cfb0e9af186fce, 0c10c84afe31213a, 0dad6f50ad84127b, 108f2edcfb6b67d8, 112d65cfb3e268bf) were skipped and remain held. No candidate in this window carried the legacy partial-AR marker, so no overwrite:true fills were needed.
